decision: Accept this bounded diagnostic failure and close without fit; no blocking implementation defect found.
verified: All 543 all-oracle raster maps exactly equal frozen learned-visible labels; risk sets nest verified <= potential <= all at exact cells.
Independent vectorized scoring of all three groups exactly reproduces risk counts, tolerant precision/recall and Euclidean p90; no pooled group conceals a failing sequence.
All 543 saved native camera matrices exactly reconstruct from current timestamp-matched native_predictions and fixed rig; recovered root maximum residual <9e-16.
GT calibration checked at frames 0, 450 and 900 per group: maximum matrix mismatch <=2.11e-6; projection roundtrip error <=3.21e-5 pixels.

All 55 files in previous learned-visible sealed artifact manifest still match SHA256.
required_interpretation: Metrics count frame-cell instances from 181 frames per development sequence, not independent trials or unique physical obstacles. Risk denominator is every frozen visible risk cell, including cells without opposite-eye support.

Precision and recall allow one 0.1 m grid-cell Chebyshev tolerance, including diagonal distance sqrt(2)*0.1 m. Localization uses Euclidean nearest GT-risk distance. Exact-cell recalls are separately included in independent_metric_checks.json.
E0 potential recall is 0.7990173674588665, strictly below 0.8; rounding to 80% cannot pass it.

Potential support combines opposite FOV, 0.5-3 m optical-depth range, CAD mask, retained same-eye points and minimum four samples per height bin. It is an optimistic support bound for this specific direct-correspondence/rasterization domain, not a pure FOV or universal learning ceiling.

Verified support uses nearest-pixel opposite rendered depth agreement within 0.03 m. Rasterization, depth discontinuities and rounding affect this diagnostic; disagreement is not automatically proof of occlusion.

Pixel counts pool both eye samples; they are not unique 3D surfaces or risk-only counts. Potential-minus-verified includes farther-depth mismatch as well as the separately counted near-depth/occluded, nohit and unavailable categories.

Ground and unknown cells are not certified free. Labelled visible points exclude self-mask, within-0.55 m root radius, outside range, outside forward 0-4/lateral -3-3 map and unlabelled height bands; this is not complete obstacle volume.

Saved current poses derive from native gyro/encoder estimates, with privileged initial world gauge and fixed-height prior. Each native map is recentered using native root/yaw, so horizontal translation/yaw gauge cancels; this does not qualify global trajectory or long-term map registration.
All oracle variants use rendered truth diagnostically, and native variant still uses perfect rendered depth. None are measured online depth, new learned predictions or source admission.

Failure supports stopping a strictly current-binocular-correspondence learner against the full frozen visible-map target. It does not prove all learned methods, monocular priors or temporal evidence incapable of useful inference.

next_mechanism_limited_review.scope: Finite comparison to learned_visible_obstacles, nohit_surface_validity, stereo_competing_depth, safe_start_disparity_anchor, stereo_partner_ownership and dual_eye_memory_conflict protocols only; not exhaustive novelty certification.
next_mechanism_limited_review.proposed: Pixel-level surface class plus depth, followed by fixed geometry projection, with monocular inference distinguished from binocular correspondence support.
next_mechanism_limited_review.assessment: Not an obvious repeat of the examined closed map-classifier or SGBM confidence/matching/memory mechanisms, provided the target, observation support and consumer semantics actually change and are preregistered.
prerequisites: Freeze pixel labels and unknown/nohit/ground semantics; do not relabel inferred monocular depth as stereo measurement.

Before fitting, qualify ideal pixel surface labels and depth through the proposed native-pose consumer against a clearly specified target. Perfect depth with current native rasterization already fails H/E1, so a new depth estimator alone is insufficient.
Freeze how surface classes affect ground rejection, height bins and projection; preserve uncertainty instead of silently overwriting geometric contradictions.

Use grouped development coverage and one frozen fit budget; E1 remains researcher-seen development and fresh verification is separate. Do not reopen v49 with a new network and unchanged rescue objective.
